notes: Song: 'Chasing the Roofline' (audio/roofline.wav; the mp3 is its gapless encode, stems unshifted). Tempo is constant: 90.001 BPM (period 0.66666 s), fitted on drum+mix onset envelopes, phase refined on kick attacks; first beat 0.664 s, first downbeat 0.664 s; bar k starts at first_downbeat + k*3*period. Sections start on the downbeat of the bar holding their first lyric line (short pickups stay in the previous section). Envelopes and onsets as for pdoom: 100 fps, each normalized to its 99th percentile; kick 240, snare 416, hat 530 onsets from the drums stem.
